narrative.overview: A warm editorial command reference with static-site discipline. Typography carries hierarchy, translucent panels provide material, and the ember accent is reserved for intent rather than decoration. Canonical upstream data supplies command structure only; the visual language is owned locally by this site.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper neutrals instead of cold default docs colors.
Serif display voice paired with practical sans-serif reading text.
Mono reserved for commands and code-like metadata.
Translucent framed surfaces with one consistent ambient shadow.
Sidebar-first catalog browsing on desktop, collapsible map on mobile.

rules.name: The Warm-First Rule
rules.body: The page never falls back to cold white or neutral gray. Stay in the warm paper family.

rules.name: The Ember-Is-Intent Rule
rules.body: Accent color marks interaction or emphasis. Do not spread it across large surfaces.

rules.name: The Source-Is-Structural Rule
rules.body: Upstream canonical data defines command slugs, ordering, and relationships. It does not define this site's visual language.

rules.name: The Serif-Stays-Structural Rule
rules.body: Use serif for hierarchy and brand voice, not for body copy blocks.

rules.name: The Command-Strings-Stay-Mono Rule
rules.body: Command identifiers and code tokens switch to mono instead of relying on color alone.

rules.name: The Blur-Belongs-to-Surfaces Rule
rules.body: Backdrop blur is reserved for translucent shells that already read as material.

rules.name: The Hover-Moves-a-Little Rule
rules.body: Transforms stay small and directional, usually 2px to 4px.

dos: Do keep the background anchored to #F5EFE4 and #E7DDCF.
Do use the ember accent for active state, hover emphasis, and links.
Do keep command names in IBM Plex Mono.
Do preserve the desktop sidebar as the primary catalog scan path.
Do treat upstream metadata as structural input, not as a visual design constraint.
Do keep motion short and stateful.
donts: Don't introduce dark mode with purple gradients, neon accents, or glowing particles.
Don't let the docs shell collapse into a generic theme look.
Don't import marketing-page metric blocks or repetitive feature-grid clichés.
Don't flatten hierarchy into one sans-serif voice.
Don't hide navigation behind unclear mobile affordances.
Don't copy upstream visual styling just because command semantics come from upstream.
